items.label: T2
items.content:
You may select one of the Specialty Sandwiches from the list below,
or build your own sandwich "from scratch." 
If you order a Specialty Sandwich you may still select your choice of bread, extras and condiments later.

choices.text: Reuben - Corned beef with sauerkraut and Swiss cheese

choices.label: b

choices.label: c

choices.label: d
choices.text: Dusty Dog - Smoked chicken and apple sausage with Swiss cheese

choices.label: e
choices.text: Basil Cream Chicken - Tangy basil cream dressing with chicken breast and Monterey Jack cheese
